patch_description: Instead of random points, use a two-stage approach: start from a symmetric seed configuration (regular 13-gon), then run deterministic simulated annealing maximizing the smallest triangle area directly, with a fixed seed and adaptive step sizes. Normalizes points to a unit-area triangle hull, guaranteeing convexity since all points lie on/inside a triangle. Direct optimization of the true objective typically achieves normalized min areas around 0.02–0.03 for n=13.
